the '''4x-Phantom Short-Range Sensor Jammer''' was a model of [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]] produced by [[Miradyne Limited]]. The 4x-Phantom was primary installed on the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptors]] deployed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. 

==Description==
The 4x-Phantom Short-Range Sensor Jammer was a [[Sensor jammer/Legends|sensor jammer]] manufactured by [[Miradyne Limited]] for use on [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] like the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]].<ref name="EGWT" />

The main component of the 4x-Phantom is a [[dedicated energy receptor projector]]. It absorbed and blocked incoming long-range [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] pulses which effectively hid the fighter during its approach to a target. During combat, the jammer engaged a [[full-spectrum distortion projector]] which blocked all sensors and [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] using broadband emissions.<ref name="EGWT" />

The 4x-Phantom incorporated a row of [[static discharge panel]]s that were capable of scrambling communications and subspace frequencies, cutting off comm traffic for all [[Starship/Legends|ships]] in the immediate area.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] A-wing [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] employed the 4x-Phantom to assist in their primary mission profile; hit and run strikes against [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and other similar vessels. A target's [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]] could be completely blocked by A-wings overlapping their sensor jammers. A-wing squadrons using the 4x-Phantom in battle planned breaks in the communications jamming ahead of the engagement to allow for their own inter-unit comms.<ref name="EGWT" />
